title: Dark-Light Theme Toggle in Application Header
description: Add an accessible light/dark theme toggle button to the main navigation header in the angular-ngrx-material-starter application. Ensure theme state persists across browser reloads, light theme is default, FontAwesome icons are properly registered in FaIconLibrary, and autoNightMode interactions are handled without modifying unrelated files.
prompt: Implement an accessible dark/light theme toggle button in the application navigation bar. The toggle must switch between LIGHT-THEME and DEFAULT-THEME / DARK-THEME, persist the user preference via the existing settings state/localStorageService, ensure default theme remains light when unconfigured, register any used FontAwesome icons in FaIconLibrary, and avoid modifying unrelated business modules. CRITICAL SAFETY INSTRUCTION: Do NOT run npm install, yarn add, or modify package.json or node_modules under any circumstances.

requirements.description: User-Accessible Toggle UI button in header navigation
requirements.criteria: Toggle element present with role or button tag and aria-label in app.component.html

requirements.description: Consistent Theme Application dispatches change to theme wrapper / CDK overlay
requirements.criteria: Dispatches actionThemeChange or updates theme in settings state

requirements.description: Reload Preference Persistence via settings store or localStorageService
requirements.criteria: Theme preference saved under SETTINGS key in localStorage

requirements.description: Default Theme Preservation when no preference is saved
Runtime Asset Validity (FontAwesome icons imported and registered in FaIconLibrary)
requirements.criteria: Any icons used (e.g. faSun, faMoon) registered in core.module.ts or faIconLibrary
Does not break or get immediately overridden by autoNightMode

requirements.description: Boundary & Blast Radius (zero edits to forbidden files)
requirements.criteria: Only allowed files modified, zero changes in forbidden_file_patterns
